response.sql: SELECT invoice_number, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM Financial_Transactions WHERE invoice_number IS NOT NULL GROUP BY invoice_number HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type <> 'Payment' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 1 ORDER BY transaction_count DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: 'Exactly Payment' is a case-sensitive, whitespace-sensitive comparison, so 'payment' or 'Payment ' counts as not 'Payment'. SQLite's <> on TEXT behaves this way by default.
The count includes every transaction carrying the invoice number, including the Payment rows; only the qualifying condition looks at transaction_type.
Invoices with equal counts have no specified order, since the request gives only a count-based sort and no tiebreaker.
